AUTHOR: Villon
TITLE: Automatic underwater fish species classification with limited data using few-shot learning
REGION: Reefs around Mayotte Island, Western Indian Ocean
SPECIES: 20 common coral reef fish species (Acanthuridae, Chaetodontidae, Labridae, Lethrinidae, Monacanthidae, Pomacentridae, Zanclidae), e.g. Naso elegans, Chaetodon auriga, Pomacentrus sulfureus, Abudefduf vaigiensis
DATA: Own GoPro videos (175 videos); thumbnail sets T0 = 69,169 (130 videos), T1 = 6,320 (20 videos), T2 test = 13,232 (25 videos); augmented AT0 = 691,690, AT1 = 63,200; Reptile meta-trained on MiniImageNet
V_EV: Methods (Thumbnail datasets): 'videos recorded at different sites, with different conditions (weather, lighting, depth, time of the day, seascape)'; no quantitative visibility, no stratified accuracy
D2: T0 69,169 / T1 6,320 train vs T2 13,232 test thumbnails, from disjoint videos, sites and days
D_EV: Methods: 'The three thumbnails datasets are fully independent, as they were extracted from videos recorded at different sites ... and on different days'
R_EV: Methods: all thumbnails 'extracted from 175 underwater videos recorded on reefs around Mayotte Island' with the same GoPro cameras; T2 is a held-out split of the same collection
C_EV: Methods: 'A thumbnail is defined as an image containing a single labelled fish'; pure species classification of pre-cropped thumbnails, no detection or counting output, no confidence threshold reported
E_EV: Results / Table 2: 'Accuracy is the % correct classification of models on T2 test dataset'; only classification accuracy and NLME accuracy-vs-N curves reported
ARCH: ResNet-100 (classic DL, trained on augmented thumbnails) vs Reptile few-shot learning (first-order MAML) meta-trained on MiniImageNet, 5-way 1-30 shot; NLME asymptotic accuracy model
METR: Classification accuracy (mean, SD, per species), pairwise proportion test, NLME asymptotic accuracy and images needed
NOTE: Pure few-shot classification on pre-cropped thumbnails (C_ALL = NA). Camera platform not described (GoPro videos on reefs; metadata says DOV/fixed) -> PLAT = NR. NIMG = total natural thumbnails T0+T1+T2 (69,169 + 6,320 + 13,232). PRE = ImageNet refers to Reptile meta-training on MiniImageNet; pretraining of the ResNet baseline is not stated. T2 test set is from different sites/days/trips within the same Mayotte collection; coded as not external (R1=N) consistent with 'held-out split of same dataset', verifier may disagree. Species-level accuracy differences explained by species similarity, not visibility.
